title: The Team of Two and a Third Pair of Hands
youtube_title: The Team of Two and a Third Pair of Hands | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Friendship makes room before it keeps score.
summary: At a schoolyard with a low swing and a circle of stones, Yara is just outside the fun, close to a poster project with only two brushes and a third friend. Milo changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Yara has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Cousin Pio lets the children solve it.
